help.signingText: Sign in with the email address and password the System Administrator gave you. To sign out, open the profile menu at the top right and choose Logout.
help.findingText: Open Records Management and type a name, address or ID number in the search box. Press / to jump to the search box.
help.issuingText: Open Issuance Management, choose New Issuance, pick the resident and the document type, check the details, then issue and print it on the pre-printed form.
help.forgotText: ask the System Administrator to set a temporary password for you.
help.noPermission: A page says you have no permission:

help.loadText: check that the office computer that hosts the system is on and that you are on the office network.
help.contactText: Ask your System Administrator at the barangay office.

learn.whatText: A staff-only system for the barangay office. It keeps resident records, prepares and prints documents on the barangay's pre-printed forms, keeps issuance history including Barangay ID cards, and shows summaries and reports for office use.
learn.notText: It is not a public website. Residents do not have accounts, apply online or pay online. It does not replace documents issued by other agencies.
learn.howText: It runs on a computer in the barangay office and is used over the office network. Resident data and photos stay on that computer.

terms.whoText: Only barangay office personnel with an account created by the System Administrator. Do not share your account or password.
terms.use1: Use resident information only for barangay office work.
terms.use2: Check every detail before issuing or printing a document.
terms.use3: Do not alter issued records. Corrections are made with a reason and are kept in the history.
terms.use4: Sign out when you leave the computer.
terms.activityText: Issuing, correcting and account changes are recorded with your name and the time, so the office can review them.

privacy.keptText: Resident details needed for barangay documents, resident photos, issuance history and staff activity records.
privacy.whyText: To prepare and print the documents the barangay issues and to keep an accurate record of them.
privacy.whoText: Signed-in barangay office personnel. The System Administrator has extra access to manage accounts and records.
privacy.whereText: On the barangay office computer. Resident data and photos are not uploaded to the internet.
privacy.retentionText: How long records are kept and how residents may ask for corrections will follow the procedures the barangay approves under the Data Privacy Act. Ask the System Administrator for details.
